description:
Cousins is the weekly podcast hosted by NBA Hall of Famers and real-life cousins Vince Carter and Tracy McGrady. From the latest NBA news to culture, entertainment, and real-life stories, this is where basketball is relative.

🎙️ New episodes every Wednesday
🏀 An AMP Sports original
🔵 Presented by FanDuel
